titulo: The door marked pull, pushed three times
caption:
The door marked pull, pushed three times

My brother pushed the door marked pull three times. Now he reads the sign first.

A sign is cheap to read and costly to ignore, and one glance usually spares the second and third try.

For whoever reads the sign before pushing the door.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right and a small sign on it that says PULL. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up and pushes the door three times with a knock, backing off with narrowed eyes each time. Then it looks up at the sign, steps back, and the door opens. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse as it walks to the doorway. The text changes from: me pushing the door that says pull, to: read the sign. it opened.
